- Central US: 3–4 business days

How do I find my tracking link?
You can find your tracking link in the shipping confirmation email from K9 Ballistics. Clicking the tracking number in that email opens the tracking information.
If you can’t find the email, you can also view your order status by logging into your account with the email used to place the order. If you didn’t create an account, one was created automatically when you placed the order, and a login code will be sent to that email address.
If your order was split into multiple packages, the email may show the primary tracking number first, and you can check the other package statuses through FedEx from there.
